verdict.rationale: OpenAI documents its own guardrail primitive: a free Moderation API, presented in a safety-best-practices guide as a way to reduce unsafe content in completions. That is direct support for the moderation-endpoint part of the story. The evidence is a single line, though, and does not show how output is gated before it acts or any configurable safety settings, so coverage is only partial. Missing for 10: documented moderation endpoint details (categories, request/response), configurable safety settings, a documented pattern for gating model or tool-call output before execution, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, the platform gives me guardrail primitives — moderation endpoints, safety settings, or documented patterns for gating model output before it acts

citations.quote: OpenAI's Moderation API is free-to-use and can help reduce the frequency of unsafe content in your completions.
